subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should PR #99905 land this broad fail-closed read-policy and Google Chat reaction-action compatibility change as the canonical fix for channel reads outside allowlists?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it intentionally changes runtime behavior and a security boundary across multiple channel owners, which requires maintainer acceptance rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Land after owner review
options.body: Accept the fail-closed compatibility impact and merge this branch after exact-head CI/proof remains green.

options.title: Split Google Chat compatibility
options.body: Require a narrower follow-up or branch update if maintainers want the Google Chat reaction action removal handled separately from read-policy enforcement.

options.title: Use the competing branch
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers choose open PR #98972 as the canonical implementation path instead.

recommendation.title: Land after owner review
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed compatibility impact and merge this branch after exact-head CI/proof remains green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway auth and agent-reader history makes this the best available owner for the cross-boundary merge-risk choice.
